jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst / System Engineer CCS – Europäische Standardisierung EU-Rail (50%)
jobs.description:
Im Rahmen des europäischen Projekts «Europäische Standardisierung CCS-Strecke» arbeiten gemeinsam mit führenden internationalen Bahnindustrieunternehmen wie Siemens, Hitachi, Alstom und CAF sowie europäischen Infrastrukturbetreibern wie DB, SNCF, RFI, ÖBB, Network Rail und ProRail an der Weiterentwicklung und Harmonisierung zukünftiger Bahnsysteme.

Das Projekt ist Teil des Europe’s Rail Joint Undertaking (ERJU) und umfasst den System Pillar sowie den Innovation Pillar. Ziel ist die Entwicklung europaweit einheitlicher Betriebsprozesse, Systemarchitekturen und technischer Spezifikationen für die zukünftigen ERTMS-Zielsysteme, insbesondere ETCS Level 2 und Automatic Train Operation (ATO GoA 1/2).

Die erarbeiteten Standards bilden die Grundlage für zukünftige europäische Betriebsvorschriften sowie für die Weiterentwicklung und Beschaffung von Sicherungsanlagen.

Zur Unterstützung der internationalen Projektarbeiten suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior Business Analyst / System Engineer im Bereich Control, Command and Signalling (CCS).

As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week.

You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. jobs.description:
About the role

Behind every well-run plant is a shared understanding of how it is performing — and that understanding has to be built. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Production & Quality at Destinus, you are the bridge between the people who run our plants and the data that describes them. Plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers own the processes; our lakehouse holds the data those processes create. Your job is to connect the two, so that every production and quality figure, from the shopfloor to the leadership team, is defined by the business, built on the lakehouse, and trusted by both.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what the business needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the production and quality data in the lakehouse and turning it into the reporting used across three European plants, including our Digital Shopfloor Management Solution, relied on by more than 300 people. You will also go to where the data is created and make it better there — improving how it is captured, automating what is still manual

As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants.

jobs.title: Staff Analyst - Risk and Fraud Systems
jobs.description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 

The Role:

Build the data, decisioning and automated systems that allow Paddle to take more good risk while reducing fraud losses, unnecessary customer friction and manual work.

jobs.title: HR Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

  • Manage day-to-day HR operations across multiple countries, including employee records, documentation and HR enquiries

  • Oversee employee onboarding and offboarding administration, ensuring all required processes are completed on time

Unser Thermostat termios Pro übernimmt den hydraulischen Abgleich automatisch, für jeden einzelnen Heizkörper, und ist in tausenden Wohnungen verbaut. Daraus entsteht ein Messdatenbestand zum realen Heizbetrieb im Gebäudebestand, wie ihn kaum ein einzelnes Forschungsprojekt aufbauen kann.

Wie viel Energie spart der automatische Abgleich wirklich, unter welchen Bedingungen, und wie weist man das sauber nach? Diese und ähnliche Fragestellungen wollen wir gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungsinstituten, Wohnungsunternehmen und Fördergebern beantworten.

jobs.title: Senior Simulation Engineering – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About the role:

As Senior Simulation Engineer – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain, you will play a key role in shaping the simulation capabilities that enable us to develop, test, and validate the next generation of autonomous ground systems at scale. You will design and evolve realistic, reliable, and reproducible virtual environments in which our autonomy software can be developed and challenged long before a physical vehicle enters the field.

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains.

Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios.

The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Own the Acute Care CT Suite roadmap and define what to build, defer, or stop based on evidence.
